active_work_package.title: P0 scope: P0.13 control-plane web after the security proof, in both plans and the P0 manual; mobile identity to P1A.14 - issue #186
active_work_package.objective: Resolve ticket #157 on the Guide v2 map: add P0.13, the control-plane web surface, to DELIVERY_PLAN.md v0.1, PLAN-001 and phases/p0.html in one package so the phase-page test's binding holds, placed after the independent security proof and outside the BT-G1 matrix; move the roadmap's mobile identity group to PLAN-001 as P1A.14; state that P0 carries no insurance function; add a P0.13 design ticket to the P0 design map.

stop_reason: WP-050 is done on this branch and awaits merge after fresh-context review, as for WP-029 through WP-049. P0 has thirteen epics in both plans and the manual: P0.13, the control-plane web surface, is the thirteenth, built after the independent security proof and outside the BT-G1 matrix, and P0 still carries no insurance function; the roadmap's mobile identity group is P1A.14 in PLAN-001 because no mobile client exists before P1. This is the one epic-row change to DELIVERY_PLAN.md v0.1 since the transition began, made in the same package as the manual's row so the phase-page test binds them still. The primary action is unchanged: NS-041, the operator's #92 waiver on #27. NS-044 now points at #165, the overview manual, which moves the gate table and two tests together; NS-043 notes the new design ticket #185 on map #128. Unchanged: NS-040 (#78), NS-024 (#93), NS-042 (#94), NS-033 (#52), NS-003 to NS-005 for the repository owner, the oracle author, experiment re-run NOT_GRANTED, NS-007 unticketed; #154 asks the operator for the roadmap's three cited documents.
